entries.source:
Transform editor Help


The transform editor uses the scripting language Lua. You may want to read Learn Lua in 15 minutes.


In practice, you don't need to know that much to use it in PlotJuggler.


You should implement the body of a function(time, value), that is invoked for each point. The returned value is the point [time, your_value]


Single input, stateless functions:

Example:

return (value * 2) + 1

or you can use the math library from Lua:

return math.log(value)

The new point will have the same time of the original point. If you want to modify the timestamp, just return two values like this:

return time +1, (value * 2)


Return multiple points at once:

Since version 3.1, you may also return multiple values at once, using a Lua table:

-- Calculate t1,v1, t2, v2, etc...

return { {t1, v1}, {t2, v2} }


Stateful functions:

Some transformations require some form of "memory", i.e. they need the previous value. To do this you may use the "global variable" textbox.

For instance, to compute the finite difference between two consecutive value, you would add this to the Global Variables textbox:

prev = nil

And this to the Function() textbox

if ( prev == nil ) then

prev = value

end

diff = value - prev

prev = value

return diff


Multi input, single output:

Select an additional time series and drop it in the table on the left side. Now your function definition will look like function(time,value,v1)

Average of two time series:

return (value + v1) / 2
entries.translation:
轉換編輯器說明


轉換編輯器使用 Lua 指令碼語言。您可以先閱讀15 分鐘學會 Lua.


實際上，在 PlotJuggler 中使用它並不需要掌握太多知識。


您需要實作以下函式的函式主體：function(time, value),它會對每個資料點呼叫一次。傳回值將構成資料點 [time, your_value]。


單輸入、無狀態函式：

範例：

return (value * 2) + 1

也可以使用 Lua 數學庫:

return math.log(value)

新資料點的時間與原資料點相同。如果需要修改時間戳記，只需像下面這樣傳回兩個值：

return time +1, (value * 2)


一次傳回多個資料點：

從 3.1 版本起，還可以使用 Lua 表一次傳回多個值：

-- Calculate t1,v1, t2, v2, etc...

return { {t1, v1}, {t2, v2} }


有狀態函式：

某些轉換需要某種形式的「記憶」，即需要前一個值。為此，可以使用「全域變數」文字框。

例如，要計算兩個相鄰值的有限差分，可以在全域變數文字框中新增以下程式碼：

prev = nil

並在 Function() 文字框中新增以下程式碼：

if ( prev == nil ) then

prev = value

end

diff = value - prev

prev = value

return diff


多輸入、單輸出：

選擇另一個時間序列並將其拖放到左側表格中。此時，函式定義將變為 function(time,value,v1)

計算兩個時間序列的平均值：

return (value + v1) / 2
